description.zh: 把值得反复听的声音，变成可以慢慢读的文字；持续整理科技、创业与 AI 播客。
description.en: Transforms videos, podcasts, and audio sources into traceable Chinese transcripts, polished long-form HTML, desktop PDFs, mobile EPUBs, and archive-ready publishing records.

quickPrompts.zh: 请把这个视频或播客整理成完整中文逐字稿，并生成可阅读交付物。
quickPrompts.en: Please turn this video or podcast into a complete Chinese transcript and readable deliverables.

quickPrompts.zh: 请检查这期播客是否已处理过，并整理可用字幕或转录来源。
quickPrompts.en: Please check whether this podcast episode has been processed and organize available subtitle or transcription sources.

quickPrompts.zh: 请基于完整逐字稿生成图文 HTML、电脑阅读 PDF 和手机 EPUB。
quickPrompts.en: Please generate an illustrated HTML article, desktop PDF, and mobile EPUB from the full transcript.

description.zh: 将用户出生信息转换为可复用的紫微斗数人生报告生成流程，报告表达避免术语堆砌、宿命化、鸡汤化和具体事件臆测。
description.en: Creates a practical Zi Wei life report from normalized birth data, solar-time correction, chart generation, and clear narrative analysis.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据我的出生信息生成一份紫微斗数人生报告
quickPrompts.en: Create a Zi Wei life report from my birth details.

quickPrompts.zh: 先帮我校正真太阳时并生成星盘
quickPrompts.en: Correct my solar time and generate the birth chart first.

quickPrompts.zh: 生成适合分享的 HTML 报告和长图
quickPrompts.en: Generate a shareable HTML report and long image.
